note: One shared glossary. Any metric label in the app maps to a definition here.

terms.Revenue: Total sales for the year — the top line, before any costs are taken out.
terms.Net income: The bottom-line profit after every cost, plus interest and tax. As a share of revenue it is called net margin.
terms.Gross margin: The share of revenue left after the direct cost of making the product. High margins signal pricing power or cheap production.
terms.Operating margin: Profit as a share of revenue after production plus the cost of running the business (R&D, sales, admin), before interest and tax.
terms.Net margin: Bottom-line profit as a share of revenue, after everything including tax and one-off items.
terms.Free cash flow: Cash left after operating the business and buying equipment — the money genuinely free to reinvest or return to shareholders.
terms.Operating cash flow: Cash generated by the core business before capital spending.
terms.Diluted EPS: Profit divided by share count, including shares that stock options could create. The per-share figure most tied to the stock price.
terms.Non-GAAP EPS: A company-adjusted per-share profit that strips out items like stock compensation and acquisition costs. Higher than GAAP, useful but not standardized.
terms.Data center revenue: Revenue from AI and server chips specifically — the segment driving the current buildout.
terms.DCAI revenue: Intel's Data Center and AI segment — its server and AI-chip business.
terms.Foundry revenue: Revenue from a chip-manufacturing arm. For Intel, mostly internal transfers, so it overstates the external business.
terms.R&D spend: What the company spent developing new chips and technology. Runs high for designers competing at the leading edge.
terms.Adjusted EBITDA: Earnings before interest, tax, depreciation, and amortization, with some items adjusted out. A rough proxy for cash profitability that ignores capital costs.
terms.AI semi revenue: AI-specific chip revenue — custom accelerators and networking silicon built for hyperscalers.
terms.Royalty revenue: For Arm, per-chip fees earned on every chip shipped using its designs. Recurring and high-margin.
terms.Licensing revenue: Up-front fees companies pay to license a chip-design IP portfolio.
terms.Market cap: The total market value of all shares: today's share price times shares outstanding. Needs a live price feed.
terms.P/E ratio: Share price divided by earnings per share — how many dollars investors pay for each dollar of annual profit.
terms.Forward P/E: The same as P/E, but using analysts' forecast of next year's earnings instead of last year's actual result.
terms.Chips shipped: Cumulative count of chips built on a company's designs — a scale indicator for an IP licensor.
terms.HBM: High-bandwidth memory, stacked next to an AI accelerator. The current bottleneck on how many accelerators can ship.
terms.CoWoS: TSMC's advanced packaging that fuses logic and memory into one accelerator. The specific capacity everyone queues for.
